citation.title: Effects of Oral Glucose Load on Endothelial Function and on Insulin and Glucose Fluctuations in Healthy Individuals

population.description: Ten non-smoking healthy subjects (4 women, 6 men) screened with an oral glucose tolerance test, no cardiovascular or chronic disease, no family disposition to glucose intolerance (Table 1). Age 41.1 +/- 3.0 and BMI 23.2 +/- 0.71 are mean +/- SEM; the SDs are computed as SEM x sqrt(10).

protocols.name: glucose_day
protocols.description: 75 g glucose in 200 mL water after a 12-hour fast (stated: subjects met at 8:00 after a 12-hour fast; glucose/placebo given between 9:00 and 9:30). Minute 0 is the load; blood before it and then at 1, 2, 3 h tabulated. Assumed: start_hour 9.25 is the midpoint of the stated 9:00-9:30 window; prefast_hours 13 is derived: 12 h fast at the 8:00 arrival plus about 1 h to the load at about 9:00-9:30.

protocols.name: placebo_day
protocols.description: Placebo day: 200 mL tap water instead of the glucose, same procedure, fast and clock as the glucose day (start_hour 9.25 and prefast_hours 13 assumed as there); no calories.

protocols.name: fasting
protocols.description: Fasting blood sample of the 10 subjects (Table 1) after the stated 12-hour fast; sample time of day not printed (blood was drawn before the load, on days that began 8:00), entered as a fasted morning with a short run-in.

findings.description: Whole venous blood glucose (HemoCue) through the 75 g glucose load, 0-180 min, mean and SEM, n=10. The 4 h point is left out (n=6).

location.where: Table 2, Blood Glucose, Glucose load column (Pre-load, 1 h, 2 h, 3 h)

findings.description: Whole venous blood glucose (HemoCue) after 200 mL tap water, 0-180 min, mean and SEM, n=10.

location.where: Table 2, Blood Glucose, Placebo load column (Pre-load, 1 h, 2 h, 3 h)

findings.description: Fasting plasma insulin of the 10 subjects (Table 1, unit printed as uU/ml; Table 2 prints uU/l for the same number, a header slip not followed), mean and SEM.

left_out.what: plasma insulin curves, glucose and placebo days (Table 2): the column header prints uU/l, read as printed 0.03 uU/mL (implausible), while Table 1 prints uU/ml for the same fasting 2.96; the unit is not corrected

4 h (240 min) glucose and insulin points, both days (Table 2): glucose n=6 because the study stopped early in 3 subjects with symptomatic hypoglycemia (those subjects are selected by the outcome); n at 4 h for the other columns not printed
samples at 15 and 30 min were drawn but not tabulated
delta flow-mediated dilation of the brachial artery (Table 2)
